title: Fact
description: One verified chart fact as rendered to the panel. Produced by deterministic PHP (FactAssembler); the language model only ever cites facts by id and never produces them. Fact values are clinical strings and numbers; they never contain the patient's name, date of birth, MRN, address or phone.

id.description: Content-derived id: first 8 hex chars of sha256(service, record_id, field). Stable across requests for the same underlying row.

category.description: Fact category; must_surface categories are appended by the OmissionGuard if the narration does not cite them.

value.description: Rendered, human-readable value. Every number and date the model states must appear verbatim in the cited fact's value.

must_surface.description: True when the OmissionGuard guarantees this fact reaches the physician even if the model omits it.

citation.description: Week 2: machine-readable provenance. For a chart fact this repeats source as a chart citation; for a value from an uploaded document it carries the document id, page and bounding box the panel highlights.
